spec.description:
Ecowool CondenShield is a lightweight, reflective foil-faced
glass mineral wool insulation blanket designed for fire safety, thermal
performance, condensation control, and acoustic absorption in metal and tile
roof systems. Manufactured with SensiTouch technology using nearly 80% recycled
glass and a natural anti-formaldehyde binder, it significantly slows heat
transfer into and out of the building while damping outside rain noise. The
reflective foil facing acts as a barrier against radiant heat and prevents
condensation accumulation beneath roof cladding.
features:
Lightweight
glass mineral wool blanket with laminated reflective aluminium foil facing

bushfire zones up to BAL-40

bio-soluble fibres

Chemically inert; non-corrosive to steel, copper, and
aluminium

install:
Roll out CondenShield blanket over roof purlins, rafters, or safety wire mesh
with foil facing downward towards the ceiling space

Ensure adjacent blanket
rolls are overlapped by minimum 50mm to 100mm

Tape all foil joints securely
with reinforced aluminium foil tape to maintain a continuous vapour barrier

Allow nominal drape of approximately 40mm between purlins if required for
condensation drainage

Install metal roofing sheets directly over the blanket,
fixing through to purlins

Ensure blanket ends extend into the gutter line
without blocking drainage channels
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof
type (metal deck or tile roof)

Determine target R-value (R1.3, R1.8, R2.5, or
R3.7) to meet NCC roof energy requirements

Calculate total roof area
including 50-100mm side overlaps

Verify foil facing specification (standard
reflective foil facing with Flammability Index ≤ 5)

Confirm supply of
matching reinforced foil tape for lap sealing
limitations:
Must not be left exposed to direct weathering prior to roof
sheet installation

Foil joints must be taped continuously to prevent
condensation breaching the vapour barrier

Do not install directly over non-IC
rated recessed lighting without proper clearances

retrieval.rag_summary:
Ecowool CondenShield is a lightweight, reflective
foil-faced glass mineral wool roofing blanket manufactured by PGF Insulation.
Available in thermal ratings from R1.3 to R3.7 (60mm to 150mm thick) in 1200mm
wide rolls, it is installed under residential and commercial metal or tile roofs
to manage condensation, block radiant heat, and dampen rain impact drumming
noise. Built with SensiTouch low-VOC bio-soluble glasswool and nearly 80%
recycled glass, its non-combustible core (AS 1530.1) and low-flammability foil
facing (Index ≤ 5) make it suitable for bushfire zones up to BAL-40.
